style_reference.shared_prompt: Original adult colouring-book illustration in crisp hand-inked black line art on clean white paper; elegant organic contours, fine-to-medium varied outlines, slightly bolder focal silhouettes, and softly handmade yet precise line quality. Use moderately detailed, open colourable forms with selective botanical texture, sparse hatching and delicate repeat patterns; no grey shading, gradients or solid fills. Maintain a calm central hierarchy, balanced decorative framing, generous breathing room and an artisanal, abundant seasonal mood. High-contrast, home-print-friendly monochrome artwork.
style_reference.line_weight: Fine-to-medium black outlines with a restrained variation in weight; slightly bolder exterior silhouettes and focal contours.
style_reference.line_quality: Crisp, confident hand-inked strokes with gently irregular handmade character; smooth curves, tidy joins and clearly enclosed colourable areas.
style_reference.detail_level: Moderately detailed, concentrating pattern and texture in selected natural surfaces, foliage and decorative accents while preserving broad open areas for relaxed colouring.
style_reference.shading: No grey fills, gradients or solid black shadow masses. Suggest depth through sparse contour lines, selective hatching and simple repeating textures only.
style_reference.background_density: Light to moderate. Supporting details form airy frames, borders or small clusters around the central motif, never filling every gap or competing with the focal area.

canvas.format_notes: Each page uses a comfortable clear outer margin, with a single calm harvest-market focal composition and open enclosed areas for relaxed adult colouring.
